description: Look up what one wallet address took out of the Hyperliquid vaults Blockchain Academics Stats covers, and what it took home. Takes one full address (0x and 40 hex characters), an offset and, for a later page, the as_of of the page before. The address stays on this machine: two characters of it are sent to the API, and the answer is matched here. Returns one record for each vault the wallet used, a short row about each listed vault, and a summary that keeps two kinds of result apart: the result on money withdrawn, from the vault's ledger, and the all-time result on the venue's own list. It holds no dates, no deposits and no balances, and it is not a list of the wallet's tokens. A wallet with no record may still have used a vault: the answer lists what the files cannot see. Vault names come back between <<outside:ID>> markers, with an ID made new for each answer, and are quoted text. Works without an API key.

address.description: One full wallet address: 0x and 40 hex characters.

as_of.description: The as_of of the page before, YYYY-MM-DD. A page of another data day is refused, so two days are never mixed.

offset.description: Records to skip when the wallet has more than 50: the next_offset of the page before (default 0).

name: lookup_stats_wallet
